name: cairn-builtin-bedrock
description: Built-in Bedrock registry pack bundled with the Cairn reference compiler. Material block ids are the flattened Bedrock identifiers; some match their Java spelling (planks, cobblestone, stairs) and some do not (standing_sign, wall_sign, wooden_pressure_plate), so each one is checked against the block table rather than assumed. The per-version block tables come from PrismarineJS/minecraft-data (data/bedrock/{1.21.0,1.21.42,1.21.60}/blocks.json, retrieved 2026-08-12); 1.21.42 is the patch release of the 1.21.40 line. Blockstate details still come from wiki.bedrock.dev.
